_comment: Shared acceptance vectors for the extension and the app. 'entities' go through validateEntity, 'manifests' through validateManifest (the POST /v1/bundles body). Where given, 'value', 'url', 'text' and 'bundleId' are the cleaned result, and 'detail' is the exact 422 detail. Regenerate with generate-entity-vectors.py.

entities.note: URL-shaped: belongs to the url kind
btc Base58Check checksum broken by one character
btc v0 with a bech32m checksum
control characters and U+2028 are stripped, then the value is checked
bidi overrides and isolates are stripped from a value

manifests.note: note keeps newlines and drops other control characters
highlight.update carries the whole annotation, with a note
a quote keeps a bidi override: it must match the page to the code unit
the page's fragment is not part of the highlight's page
highlight: a position that does not span the quote
manifests.detail: highlight.annotation.target.selector[1]: end - start must equal the length of the quote

manifests.note: highlight: on a different page from page.url
manifests.detail: highlight.annotation.target.source: must be page.url without its fragment

manifests.note: highlight: an id that is not urn:uuid
manifests.detail: highlight.annotation.id: must be urn:uuid: and a UUID v4

manifests.note: highlight: an XPath that is not a plain element path
manifests.detail: highlight.annotation.target.selector[2].startSelector.value: must be an element path such as /html[1]/body[1]/p[2], at most 1024 characters

manifests.note: highlight: a range end that is not a point
manifests.detail: highlight.annotation.target.selector[2].endSelector.refinedBy: must be a point (start equal to end)

manifests.note: highlight: a quote of only whitespace
manifests.detail: highlight.annotation.target.selector[0].exact: must not be empty or only whitespace

manifests.note: highlight: selectors in the wrong order
highlight: an empty note (omit body instead)
highlight.delete with an id that is not urn:uuid
manifests.detail: highlight.annotationId: must be urn:uuid: and a UUID v4
kind: must be one of note, entity, capture, highlight, highlight.update, highlight.delete
bundleId: must be a UUID v4
workspaceId: must be a workspace id from /v1/workspaces
page.url: must be an http(s) URL

manifests.note: clientTime that Date.parse takes but is not ISO 8601
manifests.detail: clientTime: must be an ISO 8601 time

manifests.note: clientTime that is a bare number
manifests.detail: clientTime: must be an ISO 8601 time

manifests.note: entity failing its check names the field
manifests.detail: entity.value: not an IPv4 or IPv6 address
